title: Infant at timeA, rep1
source_name_ch1: Infant at 4-6 days of life rep 1
oxygen 36 weeks postmenstrual age (wpma): 0 (finished oxygen therapy earlier than the age of 36 wPMA)
treatment_protocol_ch1: Blood samples (0.3 ml) were drawn from all the study participants on the 5th, 14th and 28th day of life for the assessment of whole genome expression in peripheral blood leukocytes.
growth_protocol_ch1: Samples were collected from children in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit of the University Children's Hospital
extract_protocol_ch1: Ficoll isopaque gradient centrifugation and RiboPure Blood Kit (Ambion, Life Technologies, Carlsbad, USA) were used for total RNA extraction
label_protocol_ch1: Biotinylated cRNA were prepared according to the standard Affymetrix protocol from 10 ng total RNA (Expression Analysis Technical Manual, 2001, Affymetrix).
hyb_protocol: GeneChip Hybridization Oven, 16-18 hours, 45oC, 60 rotations/min; washing and staining on Fluidics Station 450, protocol FS450_0007
scan_protocol: GeneChip Scanner 3000 7G controlled by GeneChip Operating Software
data_processing: Robust multiarray average (R/Bioconductor, using the library aroma.affymetrix)
contact_address: Institute for Experimental Medical Research, Oslo University Hospital - Ulleval
